'''Mika''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[damane]]''.

== Abilities and Strength ==
Mika is described able to open suitable [[Gateways]], this means that her level of strength in ''[[Saidar]]'' is above {{opsl|28}}, which is more or less the minimum strength level to open such Gateways.

==Activities==

Mika stands beside [[Mat]] for some time during the [[Last Battle]]. She opens several [[gateways]] for him. She senses [[channeling]] just before a group of [[Sharan]]s and three [[Gray Men]] attack the command post. She is most likely killed during the attack. {{ref/book|14|37}}

== Trivia ==
* Mika is named after Mikayla Micomonaco, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref>[https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=639 Theoryland Interview Database, Twitter: Fan Names in the WoT Books]</ref>
